characters.name: Commander Jax
characters.appearance: bulky white space suit, dark reflective visor, small national flag patch on shoulder

scenes.setting: barren lunar surface, Earth visible in the black sky

shots.description: Commander Jax walks with deliberate steps across the grey lunar dust, carrying a folded flag pole.
Commander Jax kneels and plants the small flag firmly into the lunar soil.
Commander Jax stands up, turns, and slowly looks up towards the distant, vibrant Earth.
Commander Jax raises a gloved hand and waves towards the Earth, the flag standing proudly beside them.
